_comment: Optional personal overrides, for repos where you do not want to commit .claude/dw.json. Copy to <research_root>/dw-repos.json. Keys are repo names (last segment of the origin URL). Fields are the same as .claude/dw.json (see dw.example.json); a repo's own .claude/dw.json wins over this file. test_globs and test_command_pattern only ADD to the fallback/preset rules.
